description: K.V.A. Rodrigo v. K.S.C.A. Rodrigo and Others K.V.A. Rodrigo v. K.S.C.A. Rodrigo and Others View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: K.V.A. Rodrigo v. K.S.C.A. Rodrigo and Others K.V.A. Rodrigo v. K.S.C.A. Rodrigo and Others View More
keywords: The appeal challenged the District Court’s refusal to accept late objections in testamentary proceedings and its appointment of the Petitioner as administrator without inquiry. Held - Sections 91A(1) and (2) of the Civil Procedure Code empowered the court to extend the time for filing objections, contrary to the trial judge’s view. Appeal allowed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
